00076 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw()
00077 :   size_(size),
00078     allocatedSize(size)
00079 {
00080     data = new float[size_];
00081     //data = (float*)malloc(size_ * sizeof(float));
00082     
00083     if(size > sourceDataSize)
00084     {
00085         memcpy(data, sourceData, sourceDataSize * sizeof(float));
00086         memset(data + size, 0, (size - sourceDataSize) * sizeof(float));
00087     }
00088     else

00090         memcpy(data, sourceData, size * sizeof(float));
00091     }
00092

00094     reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00095 #endif

00098 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw()
00099 :   size_(size),
00100     allocatedSize(size)
00101 {
00102     data = new float[size_];
00103     //data = (float*)malloc(size_ * sizeof(float));
00104     double inc = (end - start) / (size_ - 1);
00105     double currentValue = start;
00106     float *outputSamples = data;
00107     
00108     int numSamples = size_;
00109     while(--numSamples >= 0)
00110     {
00111         *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00112         currentValue += inc;
00113     }   
00114     
00115 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00116     reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00117 #endif  
00118 }

00321     {

00449 double Buffer::initFromJuceFile(const File& audioFile) throw()
00450 {
00451     if((audioFile == File::nonexistent) || (audioFile.exists() == false)) 
00452         return 0.0;
00453     
00454     AudioFormatManager formatManager;
00455     formatManager.registerBasicFormats();
00456     AudioFormatReader* audioFormatReader = formatManager.createReaderFor (audioFile);
00457     
00458     double sampleRate = audioFormatReader->sampleRate;
00459     numChannels_ = audioFormatReader->numChannels;
00460     size_ = (int)audioFormatReader->lengthInSamples;
00461     channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00462     
00463     float** bufferData = new float*[numChannels_];
00464     
00465     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00466     {
00467         channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00468         bufferData[i] = channels[i]->data;
00469     }
00470     
00471     AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numChannels_, size_);
00472     audioSampleBuffer.readFromAudioReader(audioFormatReader, 0, size_, 0, true, true);
00473     
00474     delete audioFormatReader;
00475     delete [] bufferData;
00476     return sampleRate;
00477 }

00531 double Buffer::initFromAudioFile(const char* audioFilePath) throw()
00532 {
00533     Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00534     
00535     if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00536     {   
00537         path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Bundle, audioFilePath);
00538         audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00539     }
00540     
00541     OSStatus result;
00542     UInt32 dataSize;
00543     
00544     CFURLRef audioFileURL;
00545     audioFileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL,
00546                                                            (const UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00547                                                            strlen(audioFilePath), 
00548                                                            false);
00549     
00550 //  CFStringRef string = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, audioFilePath, CFStringGetSystemEncoding());
00551 //  audioFileURL = CFURLCreateWithString(NULL, string, NULL);
00552 //  CFRelease(string);
00553     
00554     AudioFileID audioFile;
00555     result = AudioFileOpenURL (audioFileURL, kAudioFileReadPermission, 0, &audioFile);
00556     CFRelease(audioFileURL);
00557     if (result != noErr) 
00558     {
00559         printf("Could not open file: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00560         return 0.0;
00561     }
00562     
00563     SInt64 packetCount;
00564     dataSize = sizeof(packetCount);
00565     result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyAudioDataPacketCount, &dataSize, &packetCount);
00566     if (result != noErr) 
00567     {
00568         printf("Could not get packet count: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00569         AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00570         return 0.0;
00571     }
00572     
00573     AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00574     dataSize = sizeof(format);
00575     result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyDataFormat, &dataSize, &format);
00576     if (result != noErr) 
00577     {
00578         printf("Could not get data format: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00579         AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00580         return 0.0;
00581     }
00582     
00583     printf("audioFile=%p\n", audioFile);
00584     printf("sr=%f\n", (float)format.mSampleRate);
00585     printf("channels=%d\n", (int)format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00586     printf("mBytesPerPacket=%d\n", (int)format.mBytesPerPacket);
00587     printf("packetCount=%d\n", (int)packetCount);
00588     
00589     void* audioData = malloc(format.mBytesPerPacket * packetCount);
00590     
00591     if(audioData)
00592     {
00593         UInt32 packetsRead = packetCount;
00594         UInt32 numBytesRead = -1;
00595         result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile, false, &numBytesRead, NULL, 0, &packetsRead, audioData); 
00596         
00597         if (result != noErr) 
00598         {
00599             printf("Could not read audio packets: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00600             free(audioData);
00601             AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00602             return 0.0;
00603         }
00604         
00605         numChannels_ = format.mChannelsPerFrame;
00606         size_ = packetsRead;
00607         channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00608         
00609         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00610         {
00611             channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00612         }
00613         
00614         if(format.mFormatID != kAudioFormatLinearPCM)
00615         {
00616             printf("Only PCM formats supported\\n");
00617             clear();
00618         }
00619         else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat) != 0)
00620         {
00621             // float format, just need to deinterleave
00622             for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00623             {
00624                 float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00625                 float* audioFileSamples = (float*)audioData + channel;
00626                 int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00627                 
00628                 if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00629                 {
00630                     // big endian float
00631                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00632                     {
00633                         *bufferSamples = bigEndianFloat((const char*)audioFileSamples);
00634                         bufferSamples++;
00635                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00636                     }
00637                 }
00638                 else
00639                 {
00640                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00641                     {
00642                         *bufferSamples = *audioFileSamples;
00643                         bufferSamples++;
00644                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00645                     }
00646                 }
00647             }
00648         }
00649         else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00650         {
00651             // aif and other big edian?
00652             if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00653             {
00654                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00655                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00656                 {
00657                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00658                     SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00659                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00660                     
00661                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00662                     {
00663                         *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian16Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00664                         bufferSamples++;
00665                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00666                     }
00667                 }
00668             }
00669             else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00670             {
00671                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00672                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00673                 {
00674                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00675                     SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00676                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00677                     
00678                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00679                     {
00680                         *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian32Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00681                         bufferSamples++;
00682                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00683                     }
00684                 }
00685             }
00686             else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00687             {
00688                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00689                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00690                 {
00691                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00692                     char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00693                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00694                     
00695                     const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00696                     
00697                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00698                     {
00699                         *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00700                         bufferSamples++;
00701                         audioFileSamples += intInc;
00702                     }
00703                 }
00704             }
00705             else
00706             {
00707                 printf("Sound file format not yet supported.");
00708                 clear();
00709             }
00710         }
00711         else
00712         {
00713             // wav and other little edian?
00714             if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00715             {
00716                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00717                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00718                 {
00719                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00720                     SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00721                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00722                     
00723                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00724                     {
00725                         *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00726                         bufferSamples++;
00727                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00728                     }
00729                 }
00730             }
00731             else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00732             {
00733                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00734                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00735                 {
00736                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00737                     SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00738                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00739                     
00740                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00741                     {
00742                         *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00743                         bufferSamples++;
00744                         audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00745                     }
00746                 }
00747             }
00748             else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00749             {
00750                 const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00751                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00752                 {
00753                     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00754                     char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00755                     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00756                     
00757                     const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00758                     
00759                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00760                     {
00761                         *bufferSamples = (float)littleEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00762                         bufferSamples++;
00763                         audioFileSamples += intInc;
00764                     }
00765                 }
00766             }
00767             else
00768             {
00769                 printf("Sound file format not yet supported.");
00770                 clear();
00771             }
00772         }
00773     }
00774     else
00775     {
00776         printf("Could not allocate memory for audio : %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00777     }
00778     
00779     free(audioData);
00780     AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00781     
00782     return format.mSampleRate;
00783 }
00784 #endif

00920 Buffer Buffer::append(Buffer const& other) const throw()
00921 {
00922     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > other.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : other.numChannels_;
00923     const int newSize = size_ + other.size_;
00924     
00925     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, newNumChannels, false));
00926     
00927     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00928     {
00929         memcpy(newBuffer.channels[i]->data, 
00930                channels[i % newNumChannels]->data, 
00931                size_ * sizeof(float));
00932     }
00933     
00934     for(int i = 0; i < other.numChannels_; i++)
00935     {
00936         memcpy(newBuffer.channels[i]->data + size_, 
00937                other.channels[i % other.numChannels_]->data, 
00938                other.size_ * sizeof(float));
00939     }
00940     
00941     return newBuffer;
00942 }

00951         size_ = channels0.size_;

00953         for(int i = 0; i < channels0.numChannels_; i++, newIndex++)
00954         {

00956             channels[newIndex] = channels0.channels[i];

00958         
00959         for(int i = 0; i < channels1.numChannels_; i++, newIndex++)
00960         {
00961             channels[newIndex] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, 
00962                                                            channels1.size_, 
00963                                                            channels1.channels[i]->data);
00964         }
00965     }
00966     else if(channels0.size_ < channels1.size_)
00967     {
00968         size_ = channels1.size_;
00969         int newIndex = 0;
00970         for(int i = 0; i < channels0.numChannels_; i++, newIndex++)
00971         {
00972             channels[newIndex] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, 
00973                                                            channels0.size_, 
00974                                                            channels0.channels[i]->data);
00975         }
00976         
00977         for(int i = 0; i < channels1.numChannels_; i++, newIndex++)
00978         {
00979             channels1.channels[i]->incrementRefCount();
00980             channels[newIndex] = channels1.channels[i];
00981         }
00982     }
00983     else
00984     {
00985         size_ = channels0.size_;
00986         int newIndex = 0;
00987         for(int i = 0; i < channels0.numChannels_; i++, newIndex++)
00988         {
00989             channels0.channels[i]->incrementRefCount();
00990             channels[newIndex] = channels0.channels[i];
00991         }
00992

01017 Buffer Buffer::getChannel(const int channel) const throw()
01018 {

01025 
01026 Buffer Buffer::getRegion(const int startSample, 
01027                          const int endSample, 
01028                          const int startChannel, 
01029                          const int endChannel) const throw()
01030 {
01031     int newSize, newNumChannels;
01032     int sampleStep = 1, channelStep = 1;
01033     int currentChannel;
01034     
01035     if(endSample == -1)
01036         newSize = size_ - startSample;
01037     else if(endSample > startSample)
01038         newSize = endSample - startSample + 1;
01039     else
01040     {
01041         newSize = startSample - endSample + 1;
01042         sampleStep = -1;
01043     }
01044     
01045     if(startChannel == -1)
01046     {
01047         currentChannel = 0;
01048         newNumChannels = numChannels_;
01049     }
01050     else
01051     {
01052         currentChannel = startChannel;
01053         
01054         if(endChannel == -1)
01055             newNumChannels = numChannels_ - startChannel;
01056         else if(endChannel > startChannel)
01057             newNumChannels = endChannel - startChannel + 1;
01058         else
01059         {
01060             newNumChannels = startChannel - endChannel + 1;
01061             channelStep = -1;
01062         }
01063     }
01064     
01065     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, newNumChannels, false));
01066     
01067     for(int newChannelIndex = 0; newChannelIndex < newNumChannels; newChannelIndex++, currentChannel += channelStep)
01068     {
01069         const float *inputSamples = getDataReadOnly(currentChannel) + startSample;
01070         float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(newChannelIndex);
01071         int numSamples = newSize;
01072         
01073         while(numSamples--)
01074         {
01075             *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples;
01076             inputSamples += sampleStep;
01077         }
01078     }
01079     
01080     return newBuffer;
01081 }

01083 Buffer& Buffer::shrinkSize(const int amount) throw()
01084 {
01085     if(amount > 0)
01086     {
01087         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01088         {
01089             channels[i]->size_ -= amount;
01090         }
01091         
01092         size_ -= amount;
01093     }
01094     
01095     return *this;
01096 }
01097 
01098 float Buffer::sum(const int channel) const throw()
01099 {
01100     if(numChannels_ == 0 || channel < 0 || channel >= numChannels_) return 0.f;
01101     
01102     int numSamples = size_;
01103     float* inputSamples = channels[channel]->data;
01104     float sum = 0.f;
01105     
01106     while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01107         sum += *inputSamples++;
01108     }
01109     
01110     return sum;
01111 }

01113 Buffer Buffer::normalise() const throw()
01114 {
01115     float peak = findPeak();
01116     
01117     if(peak > 0.f)
01118         return *this * (1.f / peak);
01119     else
01120         return *this;
01121 }

01123 Buffer Buffer::normaliseEach() const throw()
01124 {
01125     Buffer newBuffer;
01126     
01127     if(numChannels_ > 0 && size_ > 0)
01128     {
01129         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01130         {
01131             newBuffer <<= getChannel(channel).normalise();
01132         }
01133     }
01134     
01135     return newBuffer;
01136 }

01138 float Buffer::findMaximum(const int channel) const throw()
01139 {
01140     if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) return 0.f;
01141         
01142     float value;
01143     
01144     if(channel >= 0)
01145     {
01146         value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01147         for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01148         {
01149             float newValue = getSampleUnchecked(channel, i);
01150             value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01151         }
01152     }
01153     else
01154     {
01155         value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01156         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01157         {
01158             float newValue = findMaximum(i);
01159             value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01160         }
01161     }
01162     
01163     return value;
01164 }
01165 
01166 float Buffer::findMinimum(const int channel) const throw()
01167 {
01168     if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) return 0.f;
01169     
01170     float value;
01171     
01172     if(channel >= 0)
01173     {
01174         value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01175         for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01176         {
01177             float newValue = getSampleUnchecked(channel, i);
01178             value = newValue < value ? newValue : value;
01179         }
01180     }
01181     else
01182     {
01183         value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01184         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01185         {
01186             float newValue = findMinimum(i);
01187             value = newValue < value ? newValue : value;
01188         }

01191     return value;

01194 float Buffer::findPeak(const int channel) const throw()
01195 {
01196     if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) return 0.f;
01197     
01198     float value;
01199     
01200     if(channel >= 0)
01201     {
01202         value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01203         for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01204         {
01205             float newValue = ugen::abs(getSampleUnchecked(channel, i));
01206             value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01207         }
01208     }
01209     else
01210     {
01211         value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01212         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01213         {
01214             float newValue = findPeak(i);
01215             value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01216         }
01217     }
01218     
01219     return value;   
01220 }
01221 
01222 Buffer Buffer::blend(Buffer const& other, double dfraction) const throw()
01223 {
01224     const int newNumChannels = ugen::max(numChannels_, other.numChannels_);
01225     const int maxSize = ugen::max(size_, other.size_);
01226     const int minSize = ugen::min(size_, other.size_);
01227     float fraction = ugen::max(0.f, (float)dfraction);
01228     fraction = ugen::min(1.f, fraction);
01229     
01230     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));
01231     
01232     for(int channel = 0; channel < newNumChannels; channel++)
01233     {
01234         const int thisChannel = channel % getNumChannels();
01235         const int otherChannel = channel % other.getNumChannels();
01236         
01237         for(int sample = 0; sample < minSize; sample++)
01238         {
01239             float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01240             float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01241             float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
01242             newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01243         }
01244         
01245         if(size_ < other.size_)
01246         {
01247             for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01248             {
01249                 float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01250                 float newValue = otherValue * fraction;
01251                 newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01252             }
01253         }
01254         else
01255         {
01256             for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01257             {
01258                 float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01259                 float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction);
01260                 newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01261             }           
01262         }
01263     }
01264     
01265     return newBuffer;
01266 }

01349 
01350 Buffer Buffer::loopFade(const float fadeTime, 
01351                         EnvCurve const& fadeInShape, 
01352                         EnvCurve const& fadeOutShape) const throw()
01353 {
01354     const int fadeSize = fadeTime * UGen::getSampleRate();
01355     
01356     if(fadeSize >= size_) return *this;
01357     
01358     const int newSize = size_ - fadeSize;
01359     
01360     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
01361     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01362     {
01363         float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(channel);
01364         memcpy(outputSamples, getDataReadOnly(channel), newSize * sizeof(float));
01365         
01366         const float* inputSamples = getDataReadOnly(channel) + newSize;
01367         
01368         int numSamplesToProcess = fadeSize;
01369         float fadeInLevel = 0.f;
01370         float fadeOutLevel = 1.f;
01371         float fadeSlope = 1.f / fadeSize;
01372         
01373         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
01374         {
01375             float fadeIn = *outputSamples;
01376             float fadeOut = *inputSamples;
01377             
01378             *outputSamples = fadeIn * fadeInLevel + fadeOut * fadeOutLevel;         
01379                         
01380             fadeInLevel += fadeSlope;
01381             fadeOutLevel -= fadeSlope;
01382             inputSamples++;
01383             outputSamples++;
01384         }
01385     }
01386     
01387     return newBuffer;
01388 }
01389 
01390 Buffer Buffer::resample(const int newSize) const throw()
01391 {
01392     if(size_ == newSize)
01393     {
01394         return *this;
01395     }
01396     else
01397     {
01398         Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
01399         
01400         double reciprocalNewSize = 1.0 / (double)(newSize-1);
01401         
01402         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01403         {
01404             for(int sample = 0; sample < newSize; sample++)
01405             {
01406                 float value = lookup(channel, (double)sample * reciprocalNewSize);
01407                 newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, value);
01408             }
01409         }
01410         
01411         return newBuffer;
01412     }
01413 }

01415 Buffer Buffer::changeSampleRate(const double oldSampleRate, const double newSampleRateIn) const throw()
01416 {
01417     const double newSampleRate = newSampleRateIn == 0.0 ? UGen::getSampleRate() : newSampleRateIn;
01418     
01419     if(oldSampleRate == newSampleRate)
01420     {
01421         return *this;
01422     }
01423     else
01424     {
01425         return resample(size_ * (newSampleRate / oldSampleRate));
01426     }
01427 }

01529 Buffer Buffer::blackmanWindow(const int size, const float alpha) throw()

01592 Buffer Buffer::reciprocalExceptZero() const throw()
01593 {
01594     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
01595     
01596     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
01597     {
01598         int numSamples = size_;
01599         float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
01600         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
01601         
01602         while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01603             float value = *inputSamples++;
01604             if(value == 0.f || value == -0.f)
01605                 *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
01606             else
01607                 *outputSamples++ = 1.f / value;
01608         }
01609     }
01610     
01611     return newBuffer;
01612 }

01614 Buffer Buffer::reverse() const throw()
01615 {
01616     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
01617     
01618     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
01619     {
01620         int numSamples = size_;
01621         float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data + numSamples - 1;
01622         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
01623         
01624         while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01625             *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples--;
01626         }
01627     }
01628     
01629     return newBuffer;
01630 }

01632 Buffer Buffer::mix() const throw()
01633 {
01634     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, 1, true));
01635     
01636     int channelIndex = 0;
01637     
01638     do
01639     {
01640         int numSamples = size_;
01641         float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
01642         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[0]->data;
01643         
01644         while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01645             *outputSamples++ += *inputSamples++;
01646         }
01647         
01648         channelIndex++;
01649     }
01650     while(channelIndex < numChannels_);
01651     
01652     return newBuffer;
01653 }

01655 Buffer Buffer::operator- () const throw()

01714 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator+ (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()
01715 {

01717     
01718     const float *leftRealSamples = getDataRealReadOnly();
01719     const float *leftImagSamples = getDataImagReadOnly();
01720     const float *rightRealSamples = rightOperand.getDataRealReadOnly();
01721     const float *rightImagSamples = rightOperand.getDataImagReadOnly();
01722     float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();
01723     float *newImagSamples = newBuffer.getDataImag();
01724

01726     
01727     while(numSamples--)
01728     {
01729         *newRealSamples++ = *leftRealSamples++ + *rightRealSamples++;
01730         *newImagSamples++ = *leftImagSamples++ + *rightImagSamples++;

01758 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator* (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()

01766     float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();

01774         *newImagSamples++ = (*leftImagSamples * *rightRealSamples) + (*leftRealSamples * *rightImagSamples);
01775         leftRealSamples++;
